title: Practice 13: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Buy our newspaper and win a trip to Khmelnytsky!
exercises.ru: Купите нашу газету и ___ поездку в Хмельницкий!
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
